description: Composite 3 x 3 panel group (TEM/EDS): the top-left panel is a bright-field (BF) TEM micrograph of sample M2-30, and the remaining eight panels are EDS elemental maps of the same field for Fe, Mn, Al, Si, Cr, Mo, V and Ti. Every one of the nine panels carries a white box with a "50nm" scale bar in its lower-left corner. In the BF image a grey matrix shows dark, elongated precipitates lying along a banded/boundary-like region; a red arrow labels one feature "K" and a blue arrow labels an adjacent elongated particle "(Ti,V)C". The Fe map is an almost featureless red field; Mn (green), Si (purple) and Cr (olive) are likewise uniform with no visible segregation; Al (dark blue) and Mo (near-black with sparse specks) show no identifiable localised enrichment. Only the V map displays discrete bright spots clustered in a few locations that coincide with the dark precipitates of the BF image, while the Ti map is a uniform dark grey-violet with no corresponding bright particles. The group therefore argues that V partitions into the (Ti,V)C carbides while Ti, Mn and Al do not show enrichment at the precipitates.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM micrograph with 50nm scale bar; grey matrix with dark elongated precipitates aligned along banded/boundary regions. A red arrow labels a feature 'K' and a blue arrow labels an adjacent elongated particle '(Ti,V)C'.
EDS map for Fe rendered in red; essentially uniform signal with only faint dark speckling, no localised enrichment.
EDS map for Mn rendered in green; uniform signal, no visible localised enrichment at the precipitates.
EDS map for Al rendered in dark blue; featureless uniform signal, no localised enrichment.
EDS map for Si rendered in purple; uniform signal, no segregation visible.
EDS map for Cr rendered in olive/brown; uniform signal, no localised enrichment.
EDS map for Mo rendered near-black with sparse faint specks; no clear localised enrichment.
EDS map for V rendered dark with distinct bright blue spots clustered in a few locations, indicating localised V enrichment coinciding with the precipitates in the BF image.
EDS map for Ti rendered dark grey-violet with only homogeneous speckle; no bright particles matching the (Ti,V)C precipitate positions.

observations.observation: The figure is a 3 x 3 composite: one BF TEM micrograph plus eight EDS elemental maps (Fe, Mn, Al, Si, Cr, Mo, V, Ti) of the same field.
Each of the nine panels contains a white label box with a '50nm' scale bar in the lower-left corner.
In the BF image a red arrow labels a feature 'K' and a blue arrow labels an elongated adjacent precipitate '(Ti,V)C'.
The V EDS map shows discrete bright spots clustered at a few positions, whereas the Ti map shows no corresponding bright particles.
Fe, Mn, Al, Si, Cr and Mo maps appear uniform with no visible localised enrichment at the precipitates.
The caption states the figure is the BF image of the precipitates and the composition mapping of M2-30.
The citing text asserts that V is obviously enriched at the location of (Ti, V)C carbides.
The citing text asserts that Ti is not observed enriched in Fig. 5.
The citing text asserts that for kappa-carbides no Mn or Al enrichment can be determined, indicating formation of kappa-carbides may occur by composition ordering rather than composition enrichment.
The citing text notes the same non-enrichment behaviour for kappa-carbides was reported by Zhang et al. [41].
No numeric composition, size or fraction values are printed inside any panel; the maps are qualitative only.

measured_quantities: qualitative elemental distribution maps (Fe, Mn, Al, Si, Cr, Mo, V, Ti)
unreadable_items: No numeric values are printed in any panel, so precipitate size, volume fraction and composition cannot be read from the figure
Precipitate morphology in the BF panel is faint/low-contrast; individual particle sizes cannot be measured reliably
